symbols.name: axis index
symbols.meaning: The index of a participating axis, running over the D participating axes.
symbols.quote: Here $i$ indexes the participating axes, and the letter changes meaning from its use for digit positions.

symbols.name: current axis length
symbols.meaning: The number of entries that axis i holds at the level the round processes, a power of two.
symbols.quote: Here $\ell_i$ is the current recursive length of axis $i$, the number of entries that axis holds at the level the round processes.

symbols.name: branch bit
symbols.meaning: The bit, 0 or 1, that the round writes on axis i to record which output of the butterfly an entry is.
symbols.quote: Here $\beta_i$ is the branch bit that the round writes on axis $i$, the bit recording which output of the butterfly the entry is.

symbols.name: twiddle index
symbols.meaning: The index of the twiddle on axis i, with 0 <= nu_i < ell_i/2.
symbols.quote: Here $\nu_i$ is the index of the twiddle on axis $i$, with $0 \le \nu_i < \ell_i/2$, encoded by the address bits not yet processed.

symbols.name: parallel butterfly
symbols.meaning: The tensor product of the two-point map over all participating axes, applied to the selected bits in one pass.
symbols.quote: The parallel butterfly $\Lambda$ is the tensor product of $H_0$ over the participating axes.

symbols.name: recordwise twiddle
symbols.meaning: The operation that multiplies each record at an address by the power y^eta of the polynomial variable.
symbols.quote: The recordwise twiddle $\Gamma_\eta$ multiplies each record at its address by $y^\eta$.

symbols.name: twiddle exponent
symbols.meaning: The exponent of y at an address, an integer taken modulo 2r.

relations.quote: A transform round is one stage of the [multidimensional transform](multidimensional-transform.md) on a set of participating axes.
A transform round computes its butterfly by the [simultaneous butterfly layer](simultaneous-butterfly-layer.md), which applies $\Lambda$ to the selected bits in one pass.
